title: Waste and scrap of aluminium

review.classification: UNSD CPC 3.0 pp. 203–205 distinguish metallic aluminium scrap in 39363, other metals in adjacent leaves and metal-containing ashes/residues in 39320. The unmelted sheet clippings preserve a verifiable aluminium-alloy metallic form.
review.grade_and_receiver: Verified the ReMA Tooth grade for one specified new alloy against the mixed-alloy grades. Read Novelis Revision 11 §§2, 4 and 5, including the Tier 1 audit, individual mark, banding, inspection and bale-specific rules. Non-Tier 1 bales have a distinct approval route. Novelis' RC5754 product confirms that closed-loop arrangements exist. The Innoval REALCAR case supports segregation and return. Neither establishes the exact AA5754-O lot or an operative acceptance order. Incoming sheet pallets are assigned separately from outgoing bale loads.
review.measurement_and_bilingual: Reviewed English and Chinese for dry whole released alloy, separate aluminium-element account, actual sheet/press/segregation/baling sequence, original cohort and WIP/FG allocation. Stock entries, failed-release loads and incremental service retain their own quantities. The site requires suitable source and receiver records for each physical condition. Checked the two unchanged native Mass/kg support documents against their independently authenticated byte digests.
review.maturity: The method and bilingual projection remain candidate and aligned. Native exchange identities and actual facility measurements require qualification. The independent target check is recorded separately. Range warnings were retained.

sources.role: UNSD classification and adjacent metallic and residual streams.
Single-alloy new clippings in Tooth and mixed-alloy alternatives.
Receiver specification distinguishing direct-charge certified bales, briquettes and the separate non-Tier 1 route.
Supplier’s grade-specific sheet and closed-loop agreement example.
REALCAR project participant’s account of segregated press-shop scrap returned to sheet manufacture.

delivery_gate: Full npm run validate is required on the exact integration source.
